items.title: Europe's Largest Airbus A220 Carrier Files For Chapter 11 Bankruptcy: What Next?
items.summary: Latvian flag carrier airBaltic, which also operates bases in nearby countries Estonia, Finland, and Lithuania, has filed for Chapter 11 Protection in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York. These kinds of bankruptcy proceedings are often used by airlines looking to improve their financial situation without having to put a stop to their operations altogether.

Study: You're More Likely To Have An Accident On Ryanair's Retractable Airstairs
items.summary: While retractable airstairs aren’t unique to Ryanair’s Boeing 737 aircraft, the airline group is certainly one of the largest users of this feature. Indeed, aircraft flying around with their own airstairs allows for quicker boarding and offloading, particularly at remote stands - where other aircraft would need to wait for airport services to arrive.But a study by Italy’s agency for flight safety has concluded that passengers who have used them have faced a significantly higher risk of falling…

items.title: 傳亞航財務困境 馬來西亞與競爭業者磋商航線接手預案
items.summary: （中央社吉隆坡／香港16日綜合外電報導）兩位知情人士透露，馬來西亞政府已經詢問馬來西亞航空和峇迪航空是否能夠承接亞洲航空公司在國內市場的市占率，形容這是當局密切注意亞航財務狀況的一項情境規劃。
